text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our senior-year summer has come. Despite regional races on the horizon, Matikanefukukitaru dives headfirst into summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Summer has come once more. Oh, how the cicadas cry—loud enough to shatter rocks. What a sight to behold.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: That should be no surprise. This year is nothing like last year, when I struggled so much at the completely-out-of-my-league Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I was so overcome with fear back then that even your neutral expression looked as stony as a Buddhist monk statue to me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: That doesn't mean I'm about to let my guard down. I'm still going to do what I planned to do!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Let's see. I'll steel my spirits under a waterfall, practice Zen meditation, climb up a mountain and blow a conch shell at the peak… Things like that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And after that, I hope to drop by the rickety penny candy store on the outskirts of town and win me a candy raffle.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Once there's nothing more to do, I'll let luck take the wheel! Or, as they say…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Do my best and let the gods do the rest."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Isn't it a little strange to wait for destiny to do its thing? It just feels kinda passive…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Okay then, how does this sound? "Do my best to leave the gods impressed!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go out there and snatch all the luck I can! Our training starts now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru breaks into a run underneath the bright summer sky. I get the feeling this summer is going to be exciting.
